title: Agents can pay for what they use.
text: x402 lets an agent pay per request from its own wallet, with no bank account or sign-up, and Cloudflare and AWS already support it.

title: Micropayments make premium data affordable.
text: Data that normally costs hundreds of dollars cost an agent five cents a query.

title: When agents write the code, review is the bottleneck.
text: At PostHog agents write 81% of pull requests. Review is now done by agents checking correctness, security and performance, with a judge that fixes the code or escalates to a person.

title: Automate approval, but not everywhere.
text: Agents can approve changes behind deterministic rules, while anything touching auth, CI or billing always goes to a person. Pull requests got bigger and reverts went down.

title: Agents need constraints more than context.
text: Keeping coding agents inside a design system came from narrowing what they see and feeding rule violations straight back into their loop. One screen's context fell from 17,000 tokens to about 1,400.
